analyst_view.overall: Heerenveen have won their last five matches and are hard to beat at home. Giovanni van Bronckhorst's Feyenoord are four games without a win, including draws with PSV and Fortuna Sittard, and they lost 3-0 at home to Inter in the Champions League on Tuesday. Van Bronckhorst admits the pressure is growing and says his team needs to manage its physical effort better. This is Feyenoord's last game before the international break.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, which looks high. Heerenveen have conceded only four in their last six, and Van Bronckhorst says they sometimes drop into a back five. Feyenoord have scored less than expected recently and are without defenders Jeremiah St. Juste, Thomas Beelen, Gijs Smal, Bart Nieuwkoop and Jordan Bos. We expect Feyenoord to be careful after a tiring European week.

corners.text: The numbers say about 9.8 corners, slightly more for Feyenoord. If Heerenveen sit deeper at times, Feyenoord should win their share of corners, which matches the model. Nothing points clearly away from it.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.6 cards, with Danny Makkelie refereeing. A frustrated Feyenoord under pressure could pick up a booking or two, but we found no disciplinary news or suspensions, so we stay close to the model.

shots.text: The numbers say about 29 shots. Heerenveen play freely at home, while Feyenoord are tired after Inter but desperate for a win. These pull in opposite directions, so we stay with the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. Feyenoord lacked a cutting edge against Inter, and Shaqueel van Persie is only fit enough for part of the second half. With Heerenveen tight at the back, we expect slightly fewer efforts on target than the model.
